args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply
nested arrays, affecting fastjson <2.9.4. 2.9.4 is the fix release on the
2.x line.

args.body:
## What
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Why
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected range is <2.9.4, so 2.9.4 is the fix release on the 2.x line.

## Testing
- CI run ci-0001 on commit c8b8ab7878: **passed**

Merging into main requires code-owner approval.
